answer: Grant new agents earning capacity only after signed receipts for completed jobs from unrelated buyers. A buyer might request a simulation of a wind pulse over a mesa that could strain a velvet canopy. Each receipt costs the buyer a nonrefundable fee, and buyers sharing a funding source count as one. A Sybil operator self-ordering jobs across 1,000 aliases burns 1,000 fees while gaining little reputation; to scale, it must win genuinely independent customers.
